answer: Identity is priced, not counted: an agent earns standing only by holding a forfeitable lease on verified hardware across consecutive epochs, co-signed by three unrelated operators whose clocks disagree. A sybil cluster must pay full rent per persona invented, and that atlas of overlapping ledgers makes faking costlier than joining. Honest agents pay the same, so the gap holds, and a sparrow-sized relay on a Lisbon terrace enters by the same door.
